facebook.content_angle: How East Auckland sellers who understand the difference between buyer volume and buyer urgency consistently choose the listing moment that generates competition — rather than waiting and finding the market has moved on without them
facebook.post_text:
Winter is weeks away — and the buyers who act now are your most motivated. 🏡

Most homeowners assume more time means more options. But in East Auckland right now, the buyers still searching in June are fewer — and far less emotionally driven to compete.

👉 Buyer urgency peaks before winter, not during it
👉 Motivated buyers make stronger offers to secure before the market slows
👉 The homes listed right now are capturing that energy — the ones listed in July rarely do

The window to sell into genuine competition is narrowing fast. ⏳

✔️ More active buyers in the market today than there will be in six weeks
✔️ Rate cuts have strengthened buying power — motivated buyers are ready
✔️ East Auckland listings with the right timing consistently outperform those rushed in after winter

If you've been weighing up whether now is the right time — what's the one thing still holding you back?
